tip_en: Plow maize fields to a depth of 20–25cm before planting. Deep tillage breaks hardpan layers, improves root penetration and water infiltration. Disc harrow after plowing to break clods and create a fine seedbed.
tip_ha: Noma gonon masara har zurfi santimita 20–25 kafin shuka. Noma mai zurfi yana karya ƙasan da ta taure, yana inganta shiga saiwa da ruwa. Yi amfani da disc harrow bayan noma don karya ƙudan ƙasa kuma a samar da kyakkyawan mazaunin iri.

tip_en: After harvesting previous crops, chop and incorporate residues into the soil rather than burning. This adds organic matter, improves soil structure and feeds beneficial soil organisms. Allow 3–4 weeks before planting for decomposition.
tip_ha: Bayan girbin amfanin gona na baya, yanka ragowar ka haɗa cikin ƙasa maimakon ƙona. Wannan yana ƙara kwayoyin halitta, yana inganta tsarin ƙasa kuma yana ciyar da ƙwayoyin ƙasa masu amfani. Bari makonni 3–4 kafin shuka don rushewar.

tip_en: Plant maize at 75cm between rows and 25–30cm within rows for one plant per hole, or 50cm within rows for 2 plants per hole thinned to one. This gives 40,000–53,000 plants per hectare — the optimal plant population for yield.
tip_ha: Shuka masara da tazara santimita 75 tsakanin layuka da santimita 25–30 a cikin layi don shuka ɗaya a kowace rami, ko santimita 50 a cikin layi don shuke-shuke 2 a kowace rami a rage zuwa ɗaya. Wannan yana ba da shuke-shuke 40,000–53,000 a kowace hekta — adadin shuke-shuke mafi kyau don yawan girbi.

tip_en: Use certified improved varieties such as SAMMAZ 15, AQDT 97 STR, or drought-tolerant varieties like DTMA. These yield 2–3x more than local varieties and are resistant to streak virus and drought. Source from IITA, SEEDAN, or government ADP offices.
tip_ha: Yi amfani da ingantattun nau'ukan da aka tabbatar kamar SAMMAZ 15, AQDT 97 STR, ko nau'ukan da ke jure fari kamar DTMA. Waɗannan suna ba da yawan girbi sau 2–3 fiye da nau'ukan gida kuma suna da ƙarfin jurewa da cutar streak da fari. Samu daga IITA, SEEDAN, ko ofisoshin ADP na gwamnati.

title_ha: Lokacin Da Tilas Ne Ka Kawar da Ciyawa a Masara
tip_en: Keep maize weed-free for the first 6 weeks after planting. Weeds competing during this critical period can reduce yields by 50–80%. Weed at 2–3 weeks and again at 5–6 weeks. After canopy closure (week 7–8), maize shades out most weeds naturally.
tip_ha: Kiyaye gonon masara ba tare da ciyawa ba a cikin makonni 6 na farko bayan shuka. Ciyawa da ke yin gasa a wannan lokaci mai mahimmanci na iya rage yawan girbi da kashi 50–80%. Cire ciyawa a mako 2–3 kuma a mako 5–6. Bayan rufewa (mako 7–8), masara tana inuwar mafi yawan ciyawa kai tsaye.

title_ha: Maganin Ciyawa Kafin Fitowa a Masara
tip_en: Apply Atrazine or Primextra herbicide within 3 days of planting before weeds emerge. Mix 2–3 litres per hectare in water and apply evenly on moist soil. This gives weed control for 6–8 weeks without manual weeding.
tip_ha: Yi amfani da maganin Atrazine ko Primextra a cikin kwana 3 bayan shuka kafin ciyawa ta fito. Haɗa litoci 2–3 a kowace hekta a cikin ruwa kuma a yi amfani daidai gwargwado a kan ƙasa mai ɗanshi. Wannan yana ba da maganin ciyawa na makonni 6–8 ba tare da kwance ciyawa da hannu ba.

title_en: Maize Planting Calendar for Northern Nigeria
title_ha: Jadawalin Shuka Masara a Arewacin Nijeriya
tip_en: Plant maize at the onset of reliable rains — late May to early June in the Sudan savanna and June to early July in the Sahel zone. Avoid planting too early when rains are erratic. A second crop is possible in areas with bimodal rainfall (August–September). Use 90-day varieties for the second season.
tip_ha: Shuka masara a farkon ruwan sama mai dogewa — ƙarshen Mayu zuwa farkon Yuni a Sudan savanna da Yuni zuwa farkon Yuli a yankin Sahel. Guji shuka da wuri sosai lokacin da ruwa bai daidaita ba. Ana iya shuka amfanin gona na biyu a yankunan da ke da ruwan sama biyu (Agusta–Satumba). Yi amfani da nau'ukan kwana 90 don kaka ta biyu.

tip_en: For lowland rice, puddle the field by flooding and repeatedly tilling wet soil with a rotavator or animal traction to create a compacted layer that reduces water percolation. This reduces water use by 30–40% and suppresses weed germination. Level the field after puddling for even water distribution.
tip_ha: Don shinkafar ƙasa, tsabtace gonon ta hanyar ambaliyar ruwa da noma ƙasar mai ruwa sau da yawa da rotavator ko jan nauyi don samar da ɗan murhu mai taure wanda ke rage shiga ruwa. Wannan yana rage amfani da ruwa da kashi 30–40% kuma yana hana tsirowa ciyawa. Daidaita gonon bayan tsabtacewa don rarraba ruwa daidai.

tip_en: Transplant rice seedlings at 20×20cm spacing (25 hills/m²) for optimum yields. Use 2–3 seedlings per hill. Transplant at 21–25 days after seeding in the nursery when seedlings are 15–20cm tall. Shallower transplanting (2–3cm) promotes faster tillering.
tip_ha: Dasa saiwar shinkafa da tazara santimita 20×20 (tulum 25 a kowace mita murabba'i) don mafi yawan girbi. Yi amfani da saiwa 2–3 a kowace tulum. Dasa rana 21–25 bayan shuka a lambun saiwa lokacin da saiwa ta kai santimita 15–20. Dasa mai zurfi kaɗan (santimita 2–3) yana inganta tillering da sauri.

title_en: Water Management Controls Weeds in Rice
title_ha: Sarrafa Ruwa Yana Hana Ciyawa a Shinkafa
tip_en: Maintain 5–10cm standing water in lowland rice paddies after transplanting. Continuous flooding suppresses most weeds naturally without herbicides. Hand weed at 3 and 6 weeks after transplanting. For upland rice, apply pre-emergence herbicide (Ronstar or Oxyfluorfen) within 3 days of direct seeding.
tip_ha: Kiyaye ruwa santimita 5–10 a gonon shinkafar ƙasa bayan dasa. Ambaliyar ruwa ta ci gaba tana hana mafi yawan ciyawa kai tsaye ba tare da magunguna ba. Cire ciyawa da hannu a mako 3 da 6 bayan dasa. Don shinkafar tudu, yi amfani da maganin ciyawa kafin fitowa (Ronstar ko Oxyfluorfen) a cikin kwana 3 na shuka kai tsaye.

tip_en: In Northern Nigeria, plant lowland rice from June to July for a September–November harvest. Fadama lands allow dry season rice (November–March) with irrigation. In the South, the long season runs March–July and the short season August–November. Match variety maturity (90–120 days) to your season length.
tip_ha: A Arewacin Nijeriya, shuka shinkafar ƙasa daga Yuni zuwa Yuli don girbi Satumba–Nuwamba. Ƙasashen fadama na ba da shinkafar rani (Nuwamba–Maris) tare da ban ruwa. A Kudu, doguwar damuna tana gudu Maris–Yuli da gajerar damuna Agusta–Nuwamba. Daidaita nau'in girbi (kwana 90–120) da tsawon kakar ka.

title_ha: Gadonan Da Aka Ɗaga Don Tumatur
tip_en: Prepare raised beds 1–1.2m wide and 15–20cm high for tomato. Raised beds improve drainage, reduce soil-borne diseases and make it easier to apply water and fertilizer. Incorporate compost (5–10 tonnes/ha) into the bed before transplanting. Beds should run east-west for maximum sunlight.
tip_ha: Shirya gaduna da aka ɗaga fadi mita 1–1.2 da tsayi santimita 15–20 don tumatur. Gaduna da aka ɗaga suna inganta zubewa, rage cututtukan da ke fitowa daga ƙasa kuma suna sauƙaƙa amfani da ruwa da taki. Haɗa taki na gargajiya (tan 5–10/ha) cikin gadon kafin dasa. Gaduna su yi gudu gabas-yamma don ɗaukar hasken rana sosai.

tip_en: Transplant tomato seedlings at 60×60cm for determinate varieties or 90×60cm for indeterminate varieties. Use 3–4 week old seedlings (15–20cm tall) hardened off for 1 week before transplanting. Transplant in the evening or on cloudy days to reduce transplanting shock.
tip_ha: Dasa saiwar tumatur da tazara santimita 60×60 don nau'ukan da ke girma iyakantacce ko santimita 90×60 don nau'ukan da ke girma ba iyaka ba. Yi amfani da saiwa mai mako 3–4 (tsayi santimita 15–20) da aka taurare na mako 1 kafin dasa. Dasa da yamma ko ranar gajimare don rage damuwar dasa.

title_ha: Rufe Ƙasa Yana Hana Ciyawa a Tumatur
tip_en: Apply 5–8cm thick mulch of dry grass, straw or black polythene around tomato plants. Mulching suppresses weeds, conserves soil moisture and reduces soil splash that spreads fungal diseases. Black polythene mulch is most effective — it blocks all light and prevents weed germination entirely.
tip_ha: Yi amfani da mulch kauri santimita 5–8 na ciyawa mai bushewa, ciyawa ko polyethene baƙi a kusa da shuke-shuken tumatur. Mulching yana hana ciyawa, yana adana ɗanshin ƙasa kuma yana rage tofawa ƙasa da ke yaɗa cututtukan fungi. Mulch na polyethene baƙi shine mafi tasiri — yana toshe duk haske kuma yana hana tsirowa ciyawa gaba ɗaya.

title_en: Best Season for Tomato in Nigeria
title_ha: Mafi Kyawun Lokaci Don Tumatur a Nijeriya
tip_en: The dry season (October–March) gives the best tomato yields in Northern Nigeria with irrigation — less disease pressure, lower humidity and better fruit quality. The rainy season crop suffers from blight and cracking. Start nursery in September for October transplanting. In the South, plant at the onset of the dry season (November–December).
tip_ha: Lokacin rani (Oktoba–Maris) yana ba da mafi yawan girbin tumatur a Arewacin Nijeriya tare da ban ruwa — ƙarancin cutar, ƙarancin zafi da ingancin 'ya'ya mafi kyau. Amfanin gona na damuna yana fama da blight da fissure. Fara lambun saiwa a Satumba don dasa Oktoba. A Kudu, shuka a farkon lokacin rani (Nuwamba–Disamba).

tip_en: Onion requires loose, well-drained sandy-loam to loam soil with pH 6.0–7.0. Deep till to 25cm, remove all stones and clods. Incorporate 10–15 tonnes of well-rotted compost per hectare. Avoid heavy clay soils that cause bulb rot and misshapen bulbs. Raised beds of 15cm height are recommended.
tip_ha: Albasa tana buƙatar ƙasa mai laushi, mai gudana irin yashi-lam zuwa lam da pH 6.0–7.0. Noma mai zurfi har santimita 25, cire duk duwatsu da ƙudan ƙasa. Haɗa tan 10–15 na taki na gargajiya mai kyau a kowace hekta. Guji ƙasan yumɓu mai nauyi da ke haifar da ruɓewar bulb da bulb mara siffa. Ana ba da shawarar gaduna da aka ɗaga da tsayi santimita 15.

tip_en: Transplant onion seedlings at 10×15cm or 15×15cm spacing to give 400,000–650,000 plants per hectare. Use seedlings 6–8 weeks old. Varieties suited to Northern Nigeria include Jar Rani, Dan Alhaji and Red Creole. Shallower planting depth (2–3cm) gives better bulb development.
tip_ha: Dasa saiwar albasa da tazara santimita 10×15 ko 15×15 don ba da shuke-shuke 400,000–650,000 a kowace hekta. Yi amfani da saiwa mai shekaru 6–8. Nau'ukan da suka dace da Arewacin Nijeriya sun haɗa da Jar Rani, Dan Alhaji da Red Creole. Zurfi kaɗan na dasa (santimita 2–3) yana ba da ci gaban bulb mafi kyau.

tip_en: Onion is a poor competitor — weeds must be controlled throughout. Hand weed at 3, 6 and 9 weeks after transplanting. Apply Stomp (Pendimethalin) herbicide pre-transplanting at 3 litres/ha for pre-emergence weed control. Avoid deep hoeing which damages shallow onion roots.
tip_ha: Albasa tana da ƙarancin iya gasa — dole ne a sarrafa ciyawa a duk lokaci. Cire ciyawa da hannu a mako 3, 6 da 9 bayan dasa. Yi amfani da maganin Stomp (Pendimethalin) kafin dasa da lita 3/ha don maganin ciyawa kafin fitowa. Guji raka mai zurfi wanda ke lalata saiwar albasa mai zurfi kaɗan.

title_ha: Samar da Albasa a Lokacin Rani
tip_en: Onion production in Northern Nigeria peaks in the dry season (October–April) under fadama irrigation. Start nursery in September–October, transplant November–December, harvest March–April. Cool dry conditions (15–25°C nights) promote good bulb development. Avoid high humidity which causes neck rot.
tip_ha: Samar da albasa a Arewacin Nijeriya yana kai kololuwa a lokacin rani (Oktoba–Afrilu) a ƙarƙashin ban ruwan fadama. Fara lambun saiwa a Satumba–Oktoba, dasa Nuwamba–Disamba, girba Maris–Afrilu. Yanayi mai sanyi da bushewa (dare 15–25°C) yana inganta ci gaban bulb mai kyau. Guji zafi mai ɗanshi wanda ke haifar da ruɓewar wuya.

tip_en: Cassava grows well in light sandy-loam soils. Plow to 25–30cm depth to allow tuber development. Mound or ridge planting is recommended on heavy soils to improve drainage and tuber expansion. Clear all stumps and large roots from previous crops. Cassava tolerates poor soils but responds well to good land preparation.
tip_ha: Rogo yana girma sosai a ƙasan yashi-lam mai haske. Noma har zurfi santimita 25–30 don ba da izinin ci gaban tuber. Ana ba da shawarar tulum ko layin shuka a ƙasashen nauyi don inganta gudanar ruwa da faɗaɗa tuber. Cire duk ɓaure da manyan saiwa daga amfanin gona na baya. Rogo yana jure ƙasa mai ƙarancin haihuwa amma yana amsa shirya ƙasa mai kyau.

tip_en: Select cassava stems from healthy, disease-free plants 8–12 months old. Use the middle portion of stems (avoid tips and base). Cut into 20–25cm pieces with 5–7 nodes each. Plant at 1m×1m spacing for sole cropping (10,000 plants/ha) or 1m×0.5m for higher density. Plant at 45° angle for better establishment.
tip_ha: Zaɓi sanduna rogo daga shuke-shuke masu lafiya, ba tare da cuta ba masu watanni 8–12. Yi amfani da tsakiyar sanduna (guji ƙarshen da tushe). Yanka zuwa guntuna santimita 20–25 kowanne da node 5–7. Shuka da tazara mita 1×1 don shuka ɗaya kaɗai (shuke-shuke 10,000/ha) ko mita 1×0.5 don yawan shuka. Shuka a kusurwa 45° don tsugunna mafi kyau.

title_en: Early Weed Control is Critical for Cassava
title_ha: Kawar da Ciyawa Da Wuri Yana Da Muhimmanci Don Rogo
tip_en: Weed cassava fields 2–3 times in the first 3 months — at 4, 8 and 12 weeks after planting. After 3 months the cassava canopy closes and shades out weeds. Weeds in the first 3 months can reduce yields by 40–70%. Apply pre-emergence herbicide (Galex or Dual) at planting for chemical weed control.
tip_ha: Cire ciyawa a gona rogo sau 2–3 a cikin watanni 3 na farko — a mako 4, 8 da 12 bayan shuka. Bayan watanni 3 rufin rogo yana rufewa kuma yana inuwar ciyawa. Ciyawa a cikin watanni 3 na farko na iya rage yawan girbi da kashi 40–70%. Yi amfani da maganin ciyawa kafin fitowa (Galex ko Dual) a lokacin shuka don maganin ciyawa na sinadarai.

tip_en: Plant cassava at the onset of the rainy season (May–June in the North, March–April in the South) to allow maximum growth before the dry season. In the South, a second planting in August–September is possible. Cassava can be harvested 8–24 months after planting depending on the variety.
tip_ha: Shuka rogo a farkon lokacin damuna (Mayu–Yuni a Arewa, Maris–Afrilu a Kudu) don ba da damar girma mafi yawa kafin lokacin rani. A Kudu, ana iya shuka na biyu a Agusta–Satumba. Ana iya girbin rogo watanni 8–24 bayan shuka dangane da nau'in.

tip_en: Millet grows well with minimal tillage in sandy soils. A single shallow pass with a plough or hand hoe to 10–15cm is sufficient. Deep tillage is not necessary and can increase erosion risk in sandy soils. Remove weeds and previous crop residues from the field before land preparation.
tip_ha: Gero yana girma sosai da ƙarancin noma a ƙasashen yashi. Digo ɗaya mai zurfi kaɗan da garma ko fartanya har santimita 10–15 ya isa. Noma mai zurfi ba shi da wajibi kuma na iya ƙara haɗarin zaizayar ƙasa a ƙasashen yashi. Cire ciyawa da ragowar amfanin gona na baya daga gonon kafin shirya ƙasa.

tip_en: Sow millet at 80×80cm or 75×75cm spacing with 3–4 seeds per hole, thinning to 2 plants after 2 weeks. Use 4–5 kg of seed per hectare. Improved varieties include SOSAT-C88 and Ex-Borno. Avoid monoculture — intercrop with cowpea or groundnut for better land use and nutrition.
tip_ha: Shuka gero da tazara santimita 80×80 ko 75×75 da iri 3–4 a kowace rami, a rage zuwa shuke-shuke 2 bayan makonni 2. Yi amfani da kilogiram 4–5 na iri a kowace hekta. Ingantattun nau'ukan sun haɗa da SOSAT-C88 da Ex-Borno. Guji shuka iri ɗaya kaɗai — yi gauraya da wake ko gyada don amfani mafi kyau da ƙasa da abinci.

tip_en: Striga (witch weed) is the most destructive weed in millet fields. Use Striga-resistant varieties, apply Phosphorus fertilizer at planting, and hand-pull Striga plants before they flower and set seed. Crop rotation with cowpea reduces Striga seed bank in soil. Early planting also helps the crop establish before Striga emerges.
tip_ha: Ɗan makaranta shi ne ciyawa mafi halaka a gonon gero. Yi amfani da nau'ukan da ke da ƙarfin jurewa da Striga, yi amfani da taki Phosphorus a lokacin shuka, kuma a cire shuke-shuken Striga da hannu kafin su yi fure da iri. Juyin amfanin gona da wake yana rage adadin irin Striga a cikin ƙasa. Shuka da wuri yana taimaka wa amfanin gona ya tsugunna kafin Striga ta fito.

title_en: Millet is Ideal for Sahel Conditions
title_ha: Gero Yana Da Kyau Don Yanayin Sahel
tip_en: Pearl millet is the most drought-tolerant cereal and is ideal for the Sahel and Sudan savanna zones with 300–500mm annual rainfall. Plant with the first reliable rains in June–July. Use 75–90 day varieties for reliable maturation before rains end. Millet can survive dry spells that would kill maize.
tip_ha: Geron lu'ulu'u shine hatsi mafi jurewa da fari kuma yana da kyau don yankunan Sahel da Sudan savanna da ruwan sama na millimita 300–500 a shekara. Shuka tare da farkon ruwan sama na dogewa a Yuni–Yuli. Yi amfani da nau'ukan kwana 75–90 don nuno kafin ruwa ya ƙare. Gero na iya tsira daga farin ruwa wanda zai kashe masara.

tip_en: Sorghum performs best in deep clay loam to clay soils that retain moisture. Plow to 20–25cm and harrow to break clods. Sorghum tolerates temporary waterlogging better than maize. In vertisol (black cotton soil) areas, plant sorghum on ridges to improve drainage and reduce waterlogging.
tip_ha: Dawa tana yin aiki mafi kyau a ƙasar lam-yumɓu mai zurfi zuwa ƙasar yumɓu da ke riƙe ɗanshi. Noma har santimita 20–25 kuma yi harrow don karya ƙudan ƙasa. Dawa tana jure ambaliya ta ɗan lokaci fiye da masara. A yankunan vertisol (ƙasar auduga baƙi), shuka dawa a kan layin don inganta zubewa da rage ambaliya.

tip_en: Plant sorghum at 75×20cm (3 seeds/hole, thin to 1) for sole cropping — giving about 66,000 plants/ha. For grain sorghum, use 75×30cm. Improved varieties for Northern Nigeria: SK5912, ICSV111, and SAMSORG series. Use 7–10 kg seed per hectare. Guinea-type sorghum varieties are best adapted to the Sudan savanna.
tip_ha: Shuka dawa da santimita 75×20 (iri 3/rami, rage zuwa 1) don shuka ɗaya kaɗai — yana ba da kusan shuke-shuke 66,000/ha. Don dawa don hatsi, yi amfani da santimita 75×30. Ingantattun nau'ukan don Arewacin Nijeriya: SK5912, ICSV111, da jerin SAMSORG. Yi amfani da kilogiram 7–10 na iri a kowace hekta. Nau'ukan dawa na Guinea suna daidaitawa mafi kyau da Sudan savanna.

title_ha: Lokacin Kawar da Ciyawa a Dawa
tip_en: Sorghum must be kept weed-free for the first 4–6 weeks. Weed at 3 weeks and again at 5–6 weeks after planting. After the canopy closes at 6–8 weeks, competition reduces significantly. Apply Atrazine at 1.5–2 kg a.i./ha as pre-emergence herbicide. Hand weeding twice is adequate for most smallholder plots.
tip_ha: Dole ne a kiyaye gonon dawa ba tare da ciyawa ba a cikin makonni 4–6 na farko. Cire ciyawa a mako 3 kuma a mako 5–6 bayan shuka. Bayan rufin ya rufe a mako 6–8, gasa tana raguwa sosai. Yi amfani da Atrazine a kilogiram 1.5–2 a.i./ha a matsayin maganin ciyawa kafin fitowa. Cire ciyawa da hannu sau biyu ya ishe don mafi yawan gonon ƙananan manoma.

tip_en: In Northern Nigeria plant sorghum from late June to mid-July for a November–December harvest. Late-maturing varieties (120–150 days) give higher yields but need full rainy season. Short-season varieties (90–110 days) allow planting in July for harvest before Harmattan. Sorghum is more tolerant of late-season drought than maize.
tip_ha: A Arewacin Nijeriya shuka dawa daga ƙarshen Yuni zuwa tsakiyar Yuli don girbi Nuwamba–Disamba. Nau'ukan da ke balaga a lokaci mai tsawo (kwana 120–150) suna ba da mafi yawan girbi amma suna buƙatar cikakken lokacin damuna. Nau'ukan da ke balaga a gajere (kwana 90–110) suna ba da damar shuka a Yuli don girbi kafin Iska ta Arewa. Dawa tana jure fari na ƙarshen lokaci fiye da masara.

title_en: Sandy Loam Soil is Best for Groundnut
title_ha: Ƙasar Yashi-Lam Ita Ce Mafi Kyau Don Gyada
tip_en: Groundnut performs best in well-drained, loose sandy-loam soils with pH 5.5–7.0. Avoid heavy clay soils that restrict peg penetration and pod development. Plow to 20cm depth. In heavy soils, ridge planting improves drainage. Remove all large roots and stones that interfere with pod harvesting.
tip_ha: Gyada tana yin aiki mafi kyau a ƙasar yashi-lam mai laushi, mai gudana da pH 5.5–7.0. Guji ƙasashen yumɓu mai nauyi da ke hana shiga ƙulle da ci gaban kwafi. Noma har zurfi santimita 20. A ƙasashen nauyi, layin shuka yana inganta zubewa. Cire duk manyan saiwa da duwatsu da ke tsoma baki wajen girbin kwafi.

tip_en: Plant groundnut at 45×15cm (one seed per hole) for erect varieties or 60×20cm for spreading varieties. Use 80–100 kg shelled seed per hectare. Remove seed coats just before planting to avoid fungal infection. Preferred varieties in Nigeria: SAMNUT 14, 21, 24 and ICGV series from IAR Zaria.
tip_ha: Shuka gyada da santimita 45×15 (iri ɗaya a kowace rami) don nau'ukan tsaye ko santimita 60×20 don nau'ukan da ke yaɗuwa. Yi amfani da kilogiram 80–100 na iri da aka fille a kowace hekta. Cire fatar iri kafin shuka don guji cutar fungi. Nau'ukan da ake so a Nijeriya: SAMNUT 14, 21, 24 da jerin ICGV daga IAR Zariya.

title_ha: Lokacin Da Tilas a Kawar da Ciyawa a Gyada
tip_en: Keep groundnut weed-free for the first 6 weeks. Weeds after this period have less impact on pod yield. Hand weed at 3 and 6 weeks. During earthing-up at pegging, ensure weeds are removed at the same time. Avoid deep hoeing near plants which can damage pegs and pods.
tip_ha: Kiyaye gonon gyada ba tare da ciyawa ba a cikin makonni 6 na farko. Ciyawa bayan wannan lokaci tana da ƙarancin tasiri a kan yawan kwafi. Cire ciyawa da hannu a mako 3 da 6. A lokacin dumbin ƙasa yayin ƙulle, tabbatar da cire ciyawa a lokaci guda. Guji raka mai zurfi kusa da shuke-shuke wanda zai iya lalata ƙulle da kwafi.

tip_en: Groundnut needs a warm growing season (25–30°C) with 500–1200mm rainfall. In Northern Nigeria, plant from late May to June (early rains) and harvest September–October. A dry spell at harvest aids curing and prevents aflatoxin contamination. Avoid harvesting in heavy rain — pods rot quickly in wet conditions.
tip_ha: Gyada tana buƙatar lokacin girma mai zafi (25–30°C) da ruwan sama na millimita 500–1200. A Arewacin Nijeriya, shuka daga ƙarshen Mayu zuwa Yuni (farkon ruwa) kuma girba Satumba–Oktoba. Farin ruwa a lokacin girbi yana taimakawa wajen bushewa kuma yana hana gurɓatawa da aflatoxin. Guji girbi a ruwan sama mai ƙarfi — kwafi yana ruɓewa da sauri a cikin yanayi mai ɗanshi.

tip_en: Prepare mounds 1–1.2m high and 1.5–2m apart for yam. Deep mounds allow tuber expansion and easy harvest. Incorporate organic matter (grass, compost) inside the mound. Alternatively, prepare deep furrows 30–40cm deep on flat land. Yam cannot grow in waterlogged soil — drainage is critical.
tip_ha: Shirya tulumuna tsayin mita 1–1.2 kuma nisa mita 1.5–2 don doya. Tulumuna mai zurfi na ba da damar faɗaɗa tuber da girbi mai sauƙi. Haɗa kwayoyin halitta (ciyawa, taki na gargajiya) a cikin tulum. A madadin, shirya rami mai zurfi santimita 30–40 a ƙasar lebur. Doya ba ta iya girma a ƙasa mai ambaliyar ruwa — zubewa yana da mahimmanci.

tip_en: Use healthy setts weighing 250–350g from disease-free mother tubers. Treat setts with wood ash or fungicide (Benlate) before planting to prevent rot. Plant with the cut end downward or upward — both work. Space at 1m×1m for a plant population of 10,000/ha. Use stakes or trellises to train the vines for better yields.
tip_ha: Yi amfani da gudan masu lafiya masu nauyin gram 250–350 daga tubers mahaifiyar da ba su da cuta. Yi wa gudan magani da tokar itace ko maganin fungi (Benlate) kafin shuka don hana ruɓewa. Shuka tare da ƙarshen yankan ƙasa ko sama — dukansu sun yi aiki. Sanya tazara mita 1×1 don adadin shuka 10,000/ha. Yi amfani da sanda ko tsaraƙa don horar da kudar shuka don mafi yawan girbi.

title_ha: Rufe Ƙasa Yana Hana Ciyawa a Doya
tip_en: Apply 10–15cm thick mulch of dry grass or leaves over yam mounds immediately after planting. Mulch suppresses weeds, conserves moisture and moderates soil temperature. Hand weed between mounds at 6 and 12 weeks. Avoid herbicides near yam — most are toxic to yam vines.
tip_ha: Yi amfani da mulch kauri santimita 10–15 na ciyawa mai bushe ko ganye a kan tulumuna na doya nan da nan bayan shuka. Mulch yana hana ciyawa, yana adana ɗanshi kuma yana rage canjin zafin ƙasa. Cire ciyawa da hannu tsakanin tulumuna a mako 6 da 12. Guji magunguna kusa da doya — mafi yawansu suna da guba ga kudar shuka na doya.

tip_en: Plant yam between February and April (before rains) in the Guinea savanna and forest zones of Nigeria. Early planting with irrigation or stored soil moisture gives longer growing season and higher yields. Yam requires 1500–2000mm of rainfall or equivalent irrigation. Harvest 7–8 months after planting (September–November).
tip_ha: Shuka doya tsakanin Fabrairu da Afrilu (kafin ruwa) a yankunan Guinea savanna da dazuzzuka na Nijeriya. Shuka da wuri tare da ban ruwa ko ɗanshin ƙasa da aka ajiye yana ba da tsawon lokacin girma da yawan girbi mai yawa. Doya tana buƙatar ruwan sama na millimita 1500–2000 ko ban ruwa daidai. Girba watanni 7–8 bayan shuka (Satumba–Nuwamba).

tip_en: Plant soybean at 60×5cm (3 seeds/hole, thin to 2) or 75×5cm giving 200,000–300,000 plants/ha. Always inoculate seeds with Rhizobium japonicum before planting to fix nitrogen. Mix inoculant with seed in the shade — sunlight kills Rhizobium. SAMSOY 2 and TGX varieties perform well in Northern Nigeria.
tip_ha: Shuka wake soya da santimita 60×5 (iri 3/rami, rage zuwa 2) ko 75×5 yana ba da shuke-shuke 200,000–300,000/ha. Koyaushe yi wa iri magani da Rhizobium japonicum kafin shuka don ɗaure nitrogen. Haɗa maganin a cikin inuwa — hasken rana yana kashe Rhizobium. Nau'ukan SAMSOY 2 da TGX suna yin aiki sosai a Arewacin Nijeriya.

tip_en: Plant soybean from late June to mid-July in Northern Nigeria for optimal yields. Soybean requires 450–700mm of rainfall during the growing season. The crop matures in 90–120 days — harvest in October before the Harmattan. Soybean is a good rotation crop after maize — it fixes nitrogen and breaks pest cycles.
tip_ha: Shuka wake soya daga ƙarshen Yuni zuwa tsakiyar Yuli a Arewacin Nijeriya don mafi yawan girbi. Wake soya tana buƙatar ruwan sama na millimita 450–700 a lokacin girma. Amfanin gona yana balaga a cikin kwana 90–120 — girba a Oktoba kafin Iska ta Arewa. Wake soya amfanin gona ne mai kyau don jujjuyawa bayan masara — tana ɗaure nitrogen kuma tana karya zagayoyin ƙwari.

tip_en: Plant cowpea at 75×20–30cm spacing with 2–3 seeds per hole, thinning to 1–2 plants. This gives 45,000–65,000 plants/ha. Use improved varieties such as IT90K-277-2, Ife Brown, or SAMPEA series. Intercropping cowpea with sorghum or maize is common and productive in Northern Nigeria.
tip_ha: Shuka wake da tazara santimita 75×20–30 da iri 2–3 a kowace rami, rage zuwa shuke-shuke 1–2. Wannan yana ba da shuke-shuke 45,000–65,000/ha. Yi amfani da ingantattun nau'ukan kamar IT90K-277-2, Ife Brown, ko jerin SAMPEA. Gauraya wake da dawa ko masara ya zama ruwan dare kuma yana da amfani a Arewacin Nijeriya.

title_en: Early Weeding is Enough for Cowpea
title_ha: Cire Ciyawa Da Wuri Ya Isa Don Wake
tip_en: Weed cowpea fields twice — at 2–3 weeks and 5–6 weeks after planting. After 6 weeks the crop canopy closes and shades out weeds naturally. Cowpea vines also smother late weeds. Do not weed too late — disturbing roots after flowering reduces yields. One hand weeding at 3 weeks is the minimum for smallholder plots.
tip_ha: Cire ciyawa a gonon wake sau biyu — a mako 2–3 da 5–6 bayan shuka. Bayan mako 6 rufin amfanin gona yana rufe kuma yana inuwar ciyawa kai tsaye. Kudar wake kuma yana murɗe ciyawa ta ƙarshe. Kada a cire ciyawa da jinkiri sosai — damun saiwa bayan furanni yana rage yawan girbi. Cire ciyawa ɗaya da hannu a mako 3 shine mafi ƙarancin aiki don gonon ƙananan manoma.

title_ha: Wake Yana Daidaituwa da Kowane Lokaci
tip_en: Cowpea is flexible — it can be planted from June to September in Northern Nigeria. For the main season plant in June–July. For late season planting in August–September, use early maturing varieties (60–75 days) that escape the Harmattan. Cowpea tolerates drought better than most food crops.
tip_ha: Wake yana da sassauci — ana iya shukawa daga Yuni zuwa Satumba a Arewacin Nijeriya. Don kakar shuka ta farko a Yuni–Yuli. Don shuka a ƙarshen lokaci a Agusta–Satumba, yi amfani da nau'ukan da ke balaga da wuri (kwana 60–75) da ke gujewa Iska ta Arewa. Wake na jure fari fiye da mafi yawan amfanin gona na abinci.

title_ha: Citta Tana Buƙatar Ƙasa Mai Arziki
tip_en: Ginger requires well-drained, deep, fertile loamy soil rich in organic matter. Incorporate 20–30 tonnes of compost or well-rotted manure per hectare before planting. Till to 30cm depth and break all clods. Avoid waterlogged soils — rhizomes rot easily. Slightly acidic pH (5.5–6.5) is optimal.
tip_ha: Citta tana buƙatar ƙasa mai gudana, mai zurfi, mai haihuwa kuma mai arziki da kwayoyin halitta. Haɗa tan 20–30 na taki na gargajiya ko taki na dabbobi mai kyau a kowace hekta kafin shuka. Noma har zurfi santimita 30 kuma karya duk ƙudan ƙasa. Guji ƙasashen da ke da ambaliyar ruwa — rhizome tana ruɓewa da sauƙi. pH mai ɗan acidic (5.5–6.5) yana da kyau.

tip_en: Select firm, fresh rhizomes with 2–3 viable buds (eyes) each. Break into 25–50g pieces. Allow cut surfaces to dry for 1–2 days before planting to prevent rot. Plant at 30×25cm or 45×30cm spacing at 5cm depth. Pre-sprouting rhizomes in shade for 2–3 weeks before planting improves establishment.
tip_ha: Zaɓi rhizome masu ƙarfi, masu sabon dama tare da budurori 2–3 masu yiwuwa (idanu) kowanne. Karya zuwa guntuna gram 25–50. Bar saman yankan su bushe kwana 1–2 kafin shuka don hana ruɓewa. Shuka da tazara santimita 30×25 ko 45×30 a zurfi santimita 5. Tsiro rhizome kafin shuka a inuwa na makonni 2–3 kafin shuka yana inganta tsugunna.

tip_en: Plant cucumber at 100×50cm (2 seeds/hole, thin to 1). Use trellises or stakes to train vines — trellising improves air circulation, reduces disease and increases yields by 40–60% compared to ground trailing. Cucumbers are fast-growing — first harvest in 45–55 days. Plant successively every 3–4 weeks for continuous production.
tip_ha: Shuka kokomba da santimita 100×50 (iri 2/rami, rage zuwa 1). Yi amfani da tsaraƙa ko sanda don horar da kudar shuka — tsaraƙa yana inganta zagayowar iska, rage cuta kuma yana ƙara yawan girbi da kashi 40–60% idan an kwatanta da ja a ƙasa. Kokomba yana girma da sauri — girbi na farko a cikin kwana 45–55. Shuka jere-jere kowace mako 3–4 don ci gaba da samarwa.

title_ha: Kokomba Yana Girma Duk Shekara Tare da Ban Ruwa
tip_en: Cucumber can be grown in both rainy and dry seasons with irrigation. The dry season (October–March) gives better quality fruits with fewer disease problems. Plant every month for continuous supply to markets. Cucumber is heat-tolerant but needs consistent moisture — do not allow the soil to dry out.
tip_ha: Ana iya noman kokomba a lokacin damuna da rani tare da ban ruwa. Lokacin rani (Oktoba–Maris) yana ba da 'ya'ya mafi kyau da ƙarancin matsalolin cuta. Shuka kowace wata don ci gaba da samar wa kasuwanni. Kokomba yana jure zafi amma yana buƙatar ɗanshi akai-akai — kada a bar ƙasa ta bushe.

tip_en: Raise pepper seedlings in a nursery for 6–8 weeks before transplanting. Sow seeds in trays or seedbeds with fine compost mix. Harden seedlings for 1 week in partial shade before transplanting. Transplant at 60×45cm spacing for large-fruited types or 45×30cm for chilli types. Transplant in the evening to reduce shock.
tip_ha: Noma saiwar tattasai a lambun saiwa na makonni 6–8 kafin dasa. Shuka iri a cikin kwanduna ko gadajen saiwa da haɗin taki na gargajiya mai laushi. Taurare saiwa na mako 1 a cikin ɗan inuwa kafin dasa. Dasa da tazara santimita 60×45 don nau'ukan da ke da 'ya'ya manya ko santimita 45×30 don nau'ukan barkono. Dasa da yamma don rage damuwa.

tip_en: In Northern Nigeria plant pepper nursery in September–October for dry season production (October–April) under irrigation — this gives best fruit quality and prices. In the South, plant at the start of the rainy season (February–March) for May–July harvest. Pepper dislikes waterlogging — ensure good drainage year-round.
tip_ha: A Arewacin Nijeriya shuka lambun saiwar tattasai a Satumba–Oktoba don samar da lokacin rani (Oktoba–Afrilu) da ban ruwa — wannan yana ba da ingancin 'ya'ya mafi kyau da farashin. A Kudu, shuka a farkon lokacin damuna (Fabrairu–Maris) don girbi Mayu–Yuli. Tattasai baya son ambaliyar ruwa — tabbatar da gudanar ruwa mai kyau duk shekara.

tip_en: Sow okra directly at 60×30cm spacing with 2–3 seeds per hole, thinning to 1 plant. Soak seeds in water for 12–24 hours before sowing to improve germination. Okra germinates in 5–7 days under warm conditions. First harvest in 55–65 days. Harvest pods every 2–3 days when they are 5–8cm long for best quality.
tip_ha: Shuka kubewa kai tsaye da tazara santimita 60×30 da iri 2–3 a kowace rami, rage zuwa shuka 1. Jika iri a cikin ruwa na sa'o'i 12–24 kafin shuka don inganta tsirowa. Kubewa tana tsiro a cikin kwana 5–7 a yanayi mai zafi. Girbi na farko a cikin kwana 55–65. Girbi kwafin kowace kwana 2–3 lokacin da suka kai santimita 5–8 don mafi kyawun inganci.

title_ha: Koko Tana Buƙatar Ƙasar Daji Mai Zurfi
tip_en: Cocoa grows best in deep (>1.5m), well-drained, fertile forest soils. Clear land progressively — retain shade trees such as Terminalia and leguminous species at 6×6m spacing to provide necessary shade (40–60% canopy cover). Avoid total deforestation which stresses young cocoa. Maintain leaf litter on the ground to preserve soil organic matter.
tip_ha: Koko tana girma mafi kyau a ƙasashen daji mai zurfi (>mita 1.5), mai gudana, mai haihuwa. Tsabtace ƙasa a hankali — kiyaye bishiyoyin inuwa kamar Terminalia da nau'ukan leguminous da tazara mita 6×6 don samar da inuwa da ake buƙata (rufi kashi 40–60%). Guji cire gandun daji gaba ɗaya wanda ke matsa ƙananan bishiyoyin koko. Kiyaye ganyen da ya faɗi a ƙasa don kiyaye kwayoyin halitta a ƙasa.

tip_en: Use sword suckers (narrow leaves, 1–1.5m tall) rather than water suckers (broad leaves) for planting. Trim roots and peel the outer corm layers to remove pests. Plant at 3×3m spacing (1,100 plants/ha) for pure stand or 4×4m for intercropping. The planting hole should be 60×60×60cm filled with topsoil and compost.
tip_ha: Yi amfani da saiwar takobi (ganye masu ƙunci, tsayi mita 1–1.5) maimakon saiwar ruwa (ganye masu faɗi) don shuka. Yanke saiwa da fille ɗigon corm na waje don cire ƙwari. Shuka da tazara mita 3×3 (shuke-shuke 1,100/ha) don shuka ɗaya kaɗai ko mita 4×4 don gauraya. Ramukan shuka su kasance santimita 60×60×60 cike da ƙasar saman da taki na gargajiya.

title_en: Oil Palm Spacing and Certified Seed
tip_en: Plant oil palm at 9×9m triangular spacing giving 143 palms per hectare. Always use certified tenera hybrid seed from NIFOR or PRESCO — never use wild dura palms which give 3–5x lower yields. Plant at the onset of rains. The planting hole should be 60×60×60cm. Oil palm starts bearing at 3–4 years and produces for 25+ years.
tip_ha: Shuka kwakwa da tazara mita 9×9 na murabba'i yana ba da dabi-dabi 143 a kowace hekta. Koyaushe yi amfani da tabbataccen irin tenera hybrid daga NIFOR ko PRESCO — kada a yi amfani da dabi-dabi na daji (dura) da ke ba da yawan girbi sau 3–5 ƙasa. Shuka a farkon ruwa. Ramukan shuka su kasance santimita 60×60×60. Kwakwa tana fara ɗaura 'ya'ya a shekara 3–4 kuma tana samarwa sama da shekara 25.
